integrations.visual-workspace-descriptio.meaning: A short capability description for connecting an Agent to the local visual workspace to create and edit compositions, UI sketches, and 3D spaces.
integrations.visual-workspace-descriptio.scope: WorkBuddy connector listing, bundled Skill discovery metadata, and standalone Skill marketplace listing.
integrations.visual-workspace-descriptio.referent: Human2AI's existing browser workspace and CLI collaboration capabilities.
integrations.visual-workspace-descriptio.precedence: Describes the product's capabilities; does not promise hosted storage, image generation, or automatic implementation of a finished application.
examples: Explain which visual artifacts the installed connector lets an Agent edit.

integrations.composition-example.meaning: An example user request to recover the composition of a supplied reference image as an editable canvas.
integrations.composition-example.referent: The existing reference-projection workflow for composition sessions.
integrations.composition-example.precedence: Communicates user intent without prescribing literal outlines or promising pixel-identical reconstruction.
examples: Ask to put a reference image's composition onto an editable canvas.

integrations.ui-sketch-example.meaning: An example user request to edit an existing UI sketch according to its notes and export a preview.
integrations.ui-sketch-example.referent: The existing UI-layout capture editing and preview-export workflow.
integrations.ui-sketch-example.precedence: Refers to the editable sketch; does not promise production code or changes to a deployed application.
examples: Ask the Agent to adjust a sketch using the user's notes.

integrations.spatial-example.meaning: An example user request to create a 3D space, pose a character, and export the camera view.
integrations.spatial-example.referent: The existing spatial session, character posing, and camera rendering capabilities.
integrations.spatial-example.precedence: The exported view represents the authored scene; it is not a promise to generate a photorealistic image or animation.
examples: Ask the Agent to pose a character and export a camera view.
nonExamples: Modify a composition without a spatial session.

integrations.workbuddy.description.role: connector capability description and bundled or standalone Skill discovery summary
